name: library-target-shape
body: The library target must own the module tree, not duplicate it: `src/lib.rs` declares the `mod` tree and the crate-internal API, and `src/main.rs` is a thin binary that calls into the library. No production logic may be duplicated between `lib.rs` and `main.rs`, and moving a unit into the library must not change its behaviour or its FQN.
